response.text: Journal 2459 is actually balanced (4761.64 DR vs 2380.82 + 2380.82 CR), so the period mismatch is the only issue there. Submitting findings now.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT l."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=1364 GROUP BY l."JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM(l."DR_AMT")<>SUM(l."CR_AMT")
findings.summary: Journal 1364 is out of balance: total debits 6874.61 vs credits 6883.61 (difference -9.00).

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr_t FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" WHERE i."INV_ID"=230 GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO" HAVING ROUND(SUM(l."DR_AMT"),2)<>ROUND(i."INV_AMT",2)
findings.summary: Invoice 230 (INV_AMT 6883.61) is recorded in journal 1364, whose debit total is 6874.61; the journal does not agree with the invoice amount.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr_t FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" WHERE i."INV_ID"=705 GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO" HAVING ROUND(SUM(l."DR_AMT"),2)<>ROUND(i."INV_AMT",2)
findings.summary: Invoice 705 (INV_AMT 9052.55) is linked to journal 2147, whose posted total is 9079.55; a 27.00 difference between the AP subledger and the GL.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_DT", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID" IN (465,801)
findings.summary: Invoice 801 duplicates invoice 465: same vendor V0001, same vendor invoice number (801 has a trailing space), same date 20240901 and amount 12185.45. Invoice 801 is still open and has its own journal (2458), so it risks double payment.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", i."JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_AMT"<0
findings.summary: Invoice 802 (credit memo 'CM' in INV_NO) has a negative INV_AMT of -207.62 stored in the invoice header, while its journal 2461 records the amount as positive debit/credit lines. Sign convention is inconsistent with the rest of the invoice table and the unsigned-amount convention.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."STRT_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=2459
findings.summary: Journal 2459 is assigned to period 2 (Feb 2024, closed 20240305) but has POST_DT 20240319, which falls outside period 2's date range and after its close date.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT l."JRNL_NO", l."ACCT_CD" FROM "GLJRNL" l LEFT JOIN "GLCOA" c ON TRIM(c."ACCT_CD")=TRIM(l."ACCT_CD") WHERE c."ACCT_CD" IS NULL
findings.summary: Journal 2194 posts a debit of 4018.13 to account 5950, which does not exist in the chart of accounts (GLCOA).

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", SUM(p."PAY_AMT") AS paid FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" WHERE i."INV_ID"=421 GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT" HAVING ROUND(SUM(p."PAY_AMT"),2)<>ROUND(i."INV_AMT",2)
findings.summary: Payment total for invoice 421 is 5248.89 in APPAYM versus INV_AMT 5248.88 on the invoice; the invoice is marked paid, so it is overpaid by 0.01.
